parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of returned buckets. You can leave this parameter empty. The default value is 10. The value cannot be greater than 100.

parameters.name: Prefix
parameters.description: The prefix that returned bucket names must contain. If this parameter is not specified, prefix information will not be used as a filter.
